title: Fake Roaming Alert
scenario: A text says roaming charges are extreme and asks you to install a savings profile.

answers.A: Install the profile immediately to stop the charges.
answers.B: Install it temporarily and remove it after the trip.
answers.C: Check roaming settings inside your carrier app.
answers.D: Call your carrier using the number on its official website.

explanation: A device profile can change network settings or create access. Confirm the charge and settings with your carrier first.
proTip: Your phone has not developed a personal grudge against roaming.
